definitions.short: Machalath , the name of an Ishmaelitess and of an Israelitess
definitions.full: H4258. Machalath II. מַחֲלַת proper name, feminine 1. daughter of Ishmael Gen 28:9 , ᵐ5 Μαελεθ . 2 granddaughter of David 2Chr 11:18 , ᵐ5 Μολλαθ ; ᵐ5 L Μαελλεθ . מְחֹלַת see מְחוֺלָה below I. חול .

occurrences.englishText: Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.
Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.
